message.text:
I need to identify which database tables are affected when DeleteMemo runs, including those changed directly or through explicit cascade code.

Store.DeleteMemo in store/memo.go removes the memo row, its memo_relations, and attachments. DeleteAttachment handles the attachment table. The API layer also recursively deletes comment memos before the main memo. Reactions, memo_share, and inbox may add further cascades.
Tracing `DeleteMemo` through the store and API layers to identify all affected tables.

DeleteMemo directly deletes rows from the memo_relation table.

DeleteMemo also explicitly deletes rows from the attachment and memo tables. DeleteAttachment only touches the attachment table and external storage. Reactions are not deleted by this function. Cleanup for memo_share still needs verification.

Determining which database tables DeleteMemo directly deletes from.

Store.DeleteMemo directly deletes from memo, memo_relation, and attachment. Reactions and memo_share are unaffected. The API DeleteMemo recursively deletes comment memos first.

The schema does not rely on foreign key cascades. Explicit cascade logic lives in store/memo.go.

Store.DeleteMemo directly deletes rows from memo, memo_relation, and attachment. The API handler may invoke it repeatedly, including for child comments, but each call touches those same three tables.

reaction and memo_share are not cleaned up by DeleteMemo. The affected tables remain memo, memo_relation, and attachment.
